nodes.description: Owner address state variable of Ownable; determines authorization for privileged functions.
Constructor function that assigns the deploying caller to owner.
Modifier requiring msg.sender to equal owner before the guarded function executes.
onlyOwner function that validates newOwner is non-zero and reassigns ownership.
onlyOwner function that loops over _addrs and sends _bals[i] ETH to each recipient.
Payable fallback function of DistributeETH that accepts plain ETH transfers.
Caller-controlled address used for owner assignment and for the onlyOwner authorization check.
Parameter of transferOwnership: address that receives ownership.
Parameter of distribute: array of recipient addresses supplied by the caller.
Parameter of distribute: array of ETH amounts to send to each recipient.
Loop counter local variable used in distribute.
External low-level ETH send to _addrs[i]; interacts with arbitrary addresses and can fail, causing throw.
Unchecked increment ++i of the loop counter inside distribute (arithmetic).

edges.reason: msg.sender is read inside the constructor and written into the owner state variable.
The constructor writes the caller-derived address into owner.
The onlyOwner modifier reads msg.sender to evaluate its require statement.
msg.sender is the value compared against owner in the onlyOwner authorization check.
The owner state variable is compared with msg.sender in the onlyOwner guard.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
The newOwner parameter is consumed by transferOwnership.
newOwner is assigned into the owner state variable at the end of transferOwnership.
transferOwnership performs a write to the owner state variable.
distribute iterates over the _addrs array parameter.
distribute indexes the _bals array parameter to determine transfer amounts.
_addrs[i] is the recipient target of the external send call.
_bals[i] is the value passed to the external send call.
The external send is executed within the distribute loop body.
The external send to an attacker-controlled address can invoke that address's fallback and re-enter DistributeETH's payable fallback.
distribute initialises and uses the loop counter i.
The loop condition i < _addrs.length controls the number of iterations of distribute.
The local counter i feeds the unchecked increment ++i.
The incremented value is written back into the loop counter i used by the loop condition.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is a transferOwnership parameter whose only purpose is to be validated and written to owner; it can be folded into the transferOwnership function node.
_addrs is a distribute parameter used solely as the recipient array of the loop; it can be folded into the distribute function node.
_bals is a distribute parameter used solely as the value array of the loop; it can be folded into the distribute function node.
i is a loop-local counter existing only for distribute iteration; it can be folded into the distribute function node.
